platform: win32-x64, Node 26, deterministic structural derivation over the working tree

populations.rederivationRule: the ARH2 verifier runs the shipped ARH0 and ARH1 validate() implementations against the live tree on every execution (imported, not re-implemented), so every population recorded here is re-derived on the then-current candidate and any drift fails this node together with the drifted predecessor
populations.basisDrift: ARH1's products pin candidate 260be884014110ffd3b72850509e765c8752b011, the pre-squash ARH1 branch basis; the #636 squash-merge shipped that content (with the branch's later ARH1-only fixes) as 30012d45d without branch ancestry, so ARH1's --provenance real-ancestor proof cannot pass on any checkout descended from the shipped head. Recorded here per ARH1's AC4 re-derivation obligation (record drift in basis alongside the re-derived counts); the re-derivation itself runs the shipped ARH1 verifier live against the current tree and passes, and ARH2 pins the shipped head 30012d45df4e3369728a7cc09250c5e009bfd18d as its own basis

structuralMethod: line count of each hotspot file with Rust lines() semantics (split on LF, a trailing newline does not add a line); re-derived live by the verifier on every run

godModuleBasis.classification: same classification as god_module_size_budget: .rs files under crates/*/src, excluding test fixtures (files ending _tests.rs, files named tests.rs, anything under a tests/ directory); generated data sources are included exactly as the existing guard includes them

thresholds.currentScope: the five retired Phase 11 targets only
thresholds.rule: ARH12 may extend the existing guard's walk beyond the five Phase 11 targets on exactly this measured basis (33 production files over 4000 LOC, five of them the ARH1 hotspots); 4000 is the existing ratified ceiling re-measured, not a new budget invented by this node, and no second status system is created

dimensions.measures: whether the characterized boundaries still behave as pinned (pass/fail per lane); this list is exactly the characterization product's pinned commands, joined by the verifier in both directions
dimensions.separates: behavior only: a lane's outcome is never reported as a timing, a size or a cost, and a failing lane cannot be exchanged for a cheaper one

dimensions.measures: cold project-batch semantic build time and work (wall_ns, peak_rss_bytes) with the cold/warm seam carried by the session.semantic_cold_build.calls counter and its warm-hit counterpart
dimensions.separates: the semantic project build is measured on its own cold cache state; test execution and editor/application latency never enter this dimension

dimensions.measures: the cost of the test corpus machinery itself (oracle manifest generation wall/RSS) plus the per-lane runtime of the pinned nextest lanes, taken per run
dimensions.separates: test cost is never reported as application latency or build time: the pinned behavior lanes may be run cheaply for pass/fail while their cost is accounted only here

dimensions.measures: end-to-end route latency (direct, prepared-first, prepared-repeat, batch wall_ns) of the compiled product surface the hotspots serve
dimensions.separates: latency is measured by the locked route cells on the bound runner class only; it is never derived from test-lane or build timings

numberPolicy.committedNumbers: deterministic structural counts only (populations, fileLoc, the over-threshold file count): every committed number is re-derived live by the verifier on each run
numberPolicy.wallClock: no wall-clock, RSS or speedup number is committed in any ARH2 product; measured numbers exist only in receipts produced under the ratified methodology (performance-gates.toml) on its bound runner class
numberPolicy.runnerClass: apple-silicon-laptop-8core-24gib (performance-gates.toml [runner]; a different runner class is a recalibration under that file's rules, not a local adjustment)

ac3Rationale: see the characterization product's ac3 block: ARH2 mutates no production state/query/map boundary, so fresh/incremental, edit/revert, cancellation, stale/partial and ordering are bound as existing named evidence rather than new invariants
ac4Rationale: the measurement entry points are the recorded commands and gate cells; documenting them in contributor documentation is DOC2's obligation
ac5Rationale: every dimension is bound to the existing ratified performance methodology before any measurement; no gate is weakened and no lower-LOC win is claimed (the only LOC change this node makes is a deletion with no consumer)
